{{Top|leg}}
A '''credit pad''' was an item of technology that could be used to manage an individual's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] account. It had a screen that could display amounts. [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]] used a credit pad to a display a total of credits [[Gender/Legends|she]] intended to pay the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Fonterrat]] for the information on the location of [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]].<ref name="Firestorm">{{JournalCite|15|Firestorm (short story)}}</ref>
